CRM notes (shorthand)
- Vertical: mid-tier investment platform w/ strict data residency + auditability needs.
- Primary contact: VP of Platform (Rita Chen). Procurement & Legal heavy on this one.
- Tech ask: dedicated capacity for low-latency reranking + real-time fraud scoring. Baseline target: 200 concurrent inference streams, ~2k tokens/req typical; target p95 latency < 250ms for short-context reranking; throughput guarantee: sustained 180 rps with spikes to 300 rps.
- Infra ask: reserved GPU footprint equivalent to 4x A100-80GB (or similar q4 2026 equiv). Want ability to pin model versions and guarantee KV cache warmup behavior.
- Runtime expectations: hard SLOs for p95 latency, 99.9% uptime for reserved pool, deterministic throttling vs queueing. Request automatic fallback to smaller quantized model when capacity constrained.
- Procurement/legal: main friction is DPA & MSA redlines. Key items:
  * Limit on liability — they want lower cap tied to fees; legal wants broader warranty indemnity.
  * Data residency clause — require customer-managed keys + audit rights every 6 months (vendor must accommodate).
  * Insurance schedule — require proof of cyber liability >= $5M; need carrier cert attached to contract.
  * SLA credits: procurement doesn’t accept vague credit formula that depends on third-party compliance add-ons — want flat credits tied to observed availability for Dedicated pool.
  * Termination & reserved capacity: request for termination for convenience with pro rata refunds conflicts with reserved GPU planning; engineering flagged risk on capacity re-sale.
- Pricing: interest in multi-year reserved capacity discount; procurement evaluating impact of compliance add-ons (SOC2/ISO attestation costs) on total ARR.
- Quote doc references: Exhibit A (SLA draft), Exhibit C (pricing by reserved-GPU tier) — see drive link.
- Customer quote: "We can trade some model freshness for predictable latency/cost — but contract needs clear runway and fair liability."
- Action items: legal to propose DPA redlines we can accept (detail tags), finance to validate refund/termination language with capacity ops, SE to run one more 72-hour stress test onDedicated config with our suggested fallback behavior.
- Risk note: If insurance/indemnity asks not met, procurement will push to in-house infra or cloud-provider managed endpoints (Competitor: gcp-ai-platform).
- Sales strategy: push combined Dedicated + Private trial (short-term) and bundle Optimize for caching recommendations to reduce required reserved GPUs.
